root_cause: Pricing and English route verification was gated on a successful deployment, while non-deployment readback hardcoded routesOk=true and discarded route evidence.
fix: Run pricing when browserRequired, and use both real route and pricing step outcomes for non-deployment release truth.
prevention_rule: Never mark browser-only readback LIVE_VERIFIED when route or pricing verification fails or is skipped; do not require Netlify deployment for governance-only scope.
